ops.body: - **A visible way to take a picture out of a page** (note pictures, the UI review's U1): the menu has one row, Edit, as chosen on Nov 16, so a picture leaves a page only with Backspace from after it, which a phone does not show. Recommended: a second row, "Remove from page", last, taking out the mention only (the photo stays its own moment) with the usual Undo; one more row and a check.
